# Tiny Teeth Kids' Dentistry and Orthodontics

> > Specialized pediatric dental and orthodontic care for children ages 1-18, including sedation options and special needs services across Phoenix and Goodyear, Arizona.

Tiny Teeth provides comprehensive pediatric dentistry and orthodontics with a focus on making dental care accessible through AHCCCS/Medicaid coverage and advanced technologies like digital X-rays and 3D scan imaging. The practice serves children with diverse needs, including those with developmental disabilities, and emphasizes preventative care and patient education for parents.

## Key Topics

- Pediatric Dentistry
- Orthodontics
- AHCCCS/Medicaid Insurance
- Sedation Dentistry
- Special Needs Dentistry
- Invisalign Aligners
- Digital X-Rays
- 3D Scan Technology
- Preventative Care
- Child Oral Health
- Phoenix & Goodyear Locations
- American Academy of Pediatric Dentistry
- KidsCare
- Appointment Scheduling
- Free Consultations

## Core Services

- [Tiny Teeth Kids' Dentistry and Orthodontics](https://www.tinyteeth.com): Homepage introducing Tiny Teeth's pediatric dentistry and orthodontics services
- [Pediatric Dentistry](https://www.tinyteeth.com/pediatric-dentistry): Overview of pediatric dentistry services for ages 1-18 at Tiny Teeth
- [Orthodontics](https://www.tinyteeth.com/orthodontics): Braces, Invisalign aligners, and orthodontic treatment options using 3D scans
- [Special Needs Dentistry](https://www.tinyteeth.com/special-needs-dentistry): Specialized dental care for children with developmental disabilities
- [Sedation Dentistry](https://www.tinyteeth.com/special-needs-dentistry/sedation-dentistry): Sedation options including laughing gas and IV sedation for anxious children

## Insurance & Financial

- [AHCCCS](https://www.tinyteeth.com/ahcccs): AHCCCS insurance coverage and low-cost dental care for Arizona children
- [Financial & Insurance](https://www.tinyteeth.com/financial-insurance): Insurance plans, payment options, and AHCCCS Medicaid coverage information
- [Don't Lose Your Benefits](https://www.tinyteeth.com/dont-lose-your-benefits): Guide to AHCCCS, KidsCare, and Medicaid eligibility for Arizona children

## Patient Education & Resources

- [Patient Resources](https://www.tinyteeth.com/patient-resources): Pediatric dentistry education and preventative care resources for parents
- [What to Expect](https://www.tinyteeth.com/what-to-expect): First visit guide and patient preparation information with testimonials
- [Digital X-Rays](https://www.tinyteeth.com/digital-x-rays): Educational guide on digital X-rays, safety, and cavity detection for kids
- [Fluoride](https://www.tinyteeth.com/fluoride): Parent guide on fluoride treatment and cavity prevention for children
